accounting.title: Accounting
accounting.subtitle: Journal entries posted by sales, purchases, payments and manual journals.
accounting.noJournals: No journal entries in this period.

chart.title: Chart of accounts
chart.name: Name
chart.codeHint: Suggested from the group; change it if you like.
chart.isGroupHint: Groups only hold sub-accounts; journals post to the accounts under them.
chart.activeHint: Inactive accounts take no new entries. Only an empty, unused account can be made inactive.
chart.contraHint: Opposite of the usual side for this type — a contra account (like Sales Returns).
chart.systemNote: This is a system account the app posts to. Only its name can be changed.
chart.inUseNote: This account already has entries, so its type, normal side and group setting are fixed.

errors.DUPLICATE_CODE: Another account already uses this code.
errors.INVALID_CODE: Use up to 20 letters, digits, '-' or '.'.
errors.PARENT_CYCLE: An account cannot sit under itself.
errors.TYPE_MISMATCH: An account has the same type as its group.
errors.IN_USE: Not possible once the account has entries or sub-accounts.
errors.READ_ONLY: System accounts keep their code, type and place; only the name can change.

journal.help: Each line has either a debit or a credit. Total debits must equal total credits. Only postable accounts can be used.

periods.title: Fiscal periods
periods.subtitle: Locked months cannot receive new or changed entries.
periods.help: A month can be locked once it has ended. Reopen it to correct entries.

problems.ACCOUNT_LINKED: A cash/bank account or an expense/income category still uses this account, so it stays active.
problems.ACCOUNT_HAS_BALANCE: Only an account with a zero balance can be made inactive.
